sample.title: The Deal That May Reshape the Amazon’s Future
sample.description:
Brazil sharply cut its Amazon deforestation rates through tougher enforcement. But the crisis may not have stopped so much as moved. Bloomberg Investigates explores the potential consequences of a closed-door deal that could reshape the rainforest’s future and the Bolivian frontier where environmentalists warn the next crisis is quietly unfolding.

How Saving Brazil’s Rainforest Pushed the Crisis Into Bolivia: https://bloom.bg/4bF2xdN

Destruction of the Amazon has declined dramatically in Brazil thanks to stepped-up enforcement. Across the border in Bolivia, it’s rampant.

sample.title: Why Sanctions Aren't Stopping North Korea
sample.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has raked in as much as $22 billion in foreign earnings from 2022 to 2025, according to a Bloomberg Economics analysis. That represents a 400% rise in revenues from the previous four-year period despite sweeping global sanctions. 

So how did Kim do it, and why is a richer North Korea an even bigger concern for the world?  

Read more: 
Kim Jong Un Flouted Sanctions to Amass $22 Billion Windfall
